_comment: How the ground's textures are laid, for every material (terrain_material.hlsli). tile_scale: times every material's own tile size. distance_octaves: how many times the scan may double its size as it shrinks on the screen (0: one size everywhere). octave_start_texels: texels a pixel at which the next octave starts. macro_variation: the broad light/dark variation over the scan.
